reviews.text: Able to get Ginger in the very next day for paw problem. With all access membership, visit paid for itself. All staff and the vet were helpful and nice.
Destiny at Playa location is really wonderful and always very cheerful.
The best, most caring people work here.
Thank you for the perfect rating, Maibritt! We’re delighted to know you had a great experience with us. Your support means a lot, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon!
Super friendly staff! Very knowledgeable
Dr. Shim is a knowledgeable and thorough vet!

I came to Modern after I got very put off taking my adult cat to Papaya vet (which has since closed all locations - so on point intuition) & I brought my new kitten here from the start. They are so friendly & the facility is beautiful & welcoming. The customer service is is great & it’s clear they care deeply about maintaining relationships with their clients. I love the transparent pricing & the app is super user friendly. Highly recommend.

This was my first visit to Modern Animal - I'd read good things and was excited to try a new vet in the area.

Unfortunately, my visit on 8/12 at 3:30pm with Dr. Jennifer Bonnell at the Playa Vista location was a completely unacceptable experience that wasted two hours and left my cat more stressed than when we arrived.

The technician struggled throughout the visit and seemed unfamiliar with basic cat handling. A few specifics from the visit:
- She disclosed partway through the appointment that she's allergic to cats.
- She put a towel over my cat in an attempt to calm him down, which only made him more stressed. (See picture)
- At one point she sat down on the floor in the corner of the room while the vet and I were discussing treatment options, which I found bizarre.
- She also walked me through an invoice that included services my cat didn't need, like a fecal test, which I had to catch and have corrected myself.
- She then left the room and came back five minutes later just to ask me to put my cat in the carrier myself — at every other vet I've been to, the tech or vet handles that and takes the cat back right away.
- She took my cat back for over 10 minutes, then returned saying "kitty minutes" were up and she hadn't been able to complete the bloodwork we'd aligned on with the vet. I asked directly if he'd been aggressive or scratched her, and she said no — yet she still insisted we'd need another visit, with my cat on anxiety medication beforehand. This has never happened with any other vet, and it's never even come up as something that made the procedure difficult.
- She then sold me the anxiety medication but didn't screw the cap on properly, so it spilled and I no longer have or can use it. (See picture)

Dr. Bonnell herself was kind and seemed knowledgeable, but her explanations were long-winded and hard to follow.

Staff also used my cat's name and gender inconsistently throughout the visit, which made it feel like they hadn't reviewed his history beforehand.

Given the mishandling, the incomplete service, and the medication I can no longer use due to the technician, this was a completely unprofessional, impersonal visit.

I'm reaching out to request a refund for the $100 membership, since we won't be returning, and the $27 I paid for medication I can no longer use because it spilled due to the technician.

Maybe they’re better with Dogs but I’m absolutely shocked with my experience. I hope this helps other pet owners make the right choice for their pet.

Modern Animal Playa Vista is fantastic! Everyone on the team is super friendly, helpful, and informative. My dog is actually excited to come here, and I really appreciate how transparent they are. They do most procedures right in front of you and explain everything along the way. Couldn't ask for a better vet team!
Hi Matthew, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

I've very much grown into loving Modern animal. I came from a very amazing family-owned vet in Colorado that were amazing with my pups and certified fear-free. I didn't originally like how modern animal was so corporate and not "certified" fear free. However, I've grown into loving them a lot and not sure what I would do without them 🥰. My pup, Chance was diagnosed with Addison's disease last year and we went through a really rough time, was he was very sick! In and out of the Modern Animal multiple times a day and multiple back to back days, as well as the ER. I was up for weeks with my pup all night, chatting with Modern Animal techs via their app at all sorts of hours of the night frantically worried about him whether it was his heart racing too fast, black diarrhea (bleeding in the gut), vomiting and not eating - they were there for me every step of the way and I would not have been able to get through those hard times without them. Having the assisted chats were a lifesaver for me and literally a lifesaver for Chance. All the staff and doctors were/are extremely caring, sympathetic, helpful, and accommodating when we were in the clinic and they all do their best to make it fear fear as possible, which I very much appreciate since both my pups are very scared of the vet. Having multiple locations is also very nice and convenient since they book up fast.
One of my favorite Modern Animal locations we have been to! I really like Dr Moore. She’s great!
excellent

I wrote this review when I first started using Modern Animal in 2022 when they first opened they were still working out some of the kinks. I’ve been a loyal member of their practice since and I’ve had nothing but Goldstar service ever since highly recommend excellent communication easy to get appointments. Doctors are all very good.

I had really high hopes for this veterinary practice based on their sleek marketing campaign. Unfortunately they do not live up to their own hype. I had my dog start a series of vaccinations with them and I completely forgot to schedule the second injection. Based on their marketing and social media image you would think they would contact me to let me know that I needed to come in for the second injection before it was too late. After all it is their business to make sure that the animals are cared for at least that’s what you would believe based on their marketing. And really how difficult would it be to send a text reminder to schedule an appointment?  Went in today for an appointment and was told basically that’s a you problem not our issue. So basically just the same as every other vet - don’t expect any level of care above  what is available in any other general practice. While the practice is run very efficiently it’s also very sterile with zero personalized care or investment in your animal.

After many negative experiences with Modern Animal this is the final straw. I’m just gonna leave this here.

Take a look at this screenshot. I’m so glad I pay for the “all access” membership. I sent a message in the chat about my dying cat at 7:30 AM and by 10 PM, there is still no response…
Always the best staff! Our dog loves coming here.

In a word: chaotic. We’re fortunate to have a puppy with a calm demeanor, but I can’t imagine if they had any sort of anxiety—this place made *me* anxious. Loud, rushed and transactional. It felt as if we were talking over each other and our simple questions were never answered, but rather, the tech/vet were on to the next topic. Because of this environment, critical aspects of our puppy’s care were missed. We almost left without vital medication (having to remind them), and worse, when we got home, we realized some important doses were also missing (resulting having to return at a later time). Modern Animal came highly recommended, but I can’t recommend this specific location. We’ll be doing follow up care at another branch.

Great staff! Dr Shimm explained everything thoroughly & the techs are so sweet and warm with my Harley. The space is very clean and I always feel comfortable coming here. I tell all of my friends to take their fur babies to Modern Animal.
What a great experience from start to finish.  The whole staff was loving and attentive and treated Bodie like a king.  I am glad we found Modern Animal.

Thank you, Marla! We appreciate your support and are delighted to see you enjoyed your experience. Your positive rating motivates us to keep delivering exceptional service. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

We moved to CA from CO and needed a new vet! We found this place from google searching and we are happy to report that we had a very positive experience. My dog is an extremely nervous rescue dog with some past trauma and they took great care of him, got him updated on all of his annual vaccines and gave him lots of love and treats. The office was clean and organized and working with them through the app is awesome. We’ll happily continue working with them for all of our veterinary needs.

Thanks for the fantastic rating, Howard! We appreciate your support and are excited to have you as part of our community. Your satisfaction means a lot to us, and we look forward to continuing to provide great experiences.

We had another wonderful visit to Modern Animal today with Tofu. Dr. Shim, Charlie, and Destini all did an amazing job, which comes as no surprise! Tofu was in for his rabies shot, and Charlie was so skilled that he didn’t even realize he’d been poked. Destini’s gentle holding and 'hugging' definitely helped keep him calm and happy. Thank you all for taking such great care of him!

We appreciate you taking the time to leave a rating. We're committed to providing a better experience and would love to know more about how we can improve. Your insights are valuable to us as we work to enhance our services. Thank you for sharing! Please email us at hello@modernanimal.com

We took our new puppy to Modern Animal for the first time and loved it! The staff were extremely friendly, personable and truly care about our pup's well-being. The pricing is also much more affordable than other vets. We are excited to become members and use Modern Animal as our primary vet!

Amazing doctors we truly love this place and trust them with our pets. The only downside is that sometimes it feels like they try to charge for every little thing, haha. Overall though, the care and professionalism are excellent. We love Dr Teresa Le 🐾

Wanted $1500 to neuter my cat. 1500!!!!!

I went elsewhere and spent a fraction of that, all included with anesthesia and everything.

Modern Animal gives you bang for your buck.  I have chronically ill pets who need to be seen a few times a year and MA Playa makes it so easy.  I am usually in and out within an hour, never wait long for appointments, and they are so kind and caring to my cats.  Their prices are moderate but when you don't have to pay visit fees it helps even it out. It gives me peace of mind to know that if I am traveling and godforbid something happens to my pet, I can schedule appointments, read notes, and pay remotely.

Wonderful staff, and clean clinic. It is easy to make appointments and communicate with the care team. My pup never had an issue coming here. The location is also really convenient within walking distance. 10/10 recommend.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Devin! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a great experience. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

Love everyone here! Everyone is super kind, welcoming, and super knowledgeable. This is my second year with them and the membership is worth it. I also love the app and them going over the prices of everything.
Always great service. We got an urgent care visit in a few minutes. Great and friendly staff.

Initially hesitant with the idea of a big corporate style vet... but the team there is AMAZING. You never wait too long, they're always prompt/thorough and give you a ton of attention. The customer service team is amazing. We've been dealing with a serious health issue for our senior pup who is 16 and Dr Le has been terrific - empathetic, supportive, helpful and just a wonderful person to deal with. We even asked her to throw together a letter quickly for travel insurance (due to a trip we had to cancel) and she did it within a day!
Happy with the care my three dogs get in playa vista and Manhattan Beach. Techs and managers and front desk people are great.
Great service and great care

We have had the worst time find a great vet, from Shane's who is just the worst to Paws and Palms and any VCA you can go to. We have been to them all.

Mack our pit/bulldog had a terrible ear infection and was itchy and I thought over weight. So, we tried Modern Animal and so far they are great. I hope it stays that way. I am so tired of looking.

I did not know it was a chain, but it is. This one is in Playa Vista and really nice.

The staff was great. They were ready for us within minutes of us getting there. Mack, however, enjoyed none of it. He had to have his Du nails clipped and he just refused. They got one and he will go back and I will get him so stoned first, he won't be a bother.

The ear infection was found and he has meds for that which are working. His itchy skin is being dealt with, unlike Paws and Palms which just took a guess. He now has the right cream.

And sure enough my boy is overweight, so I have him on a strict diet and he would like to give me 0 stars for his feeding. He is a pocket pity, bull dog mix with the short snout and you just can't let them get fat.

Modern Medicine seems to know what they are doing and we go back in a couple of weeks, with a high dog in tow.

We really loved the staff and the place is spotless.

Mack refused to have his photo taken.
Thank you for the fantastic rating, Mary! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you’re enjoying your experience with us. We look forward to continuing to provide great service!
Great experience and great vets!
Amazing service all around. Would def recommend

I used to be a true fan of modern animal, the ease of service, appointments and overall care for my dogs. In the two years, it seems they are just a machine to make money. Every time I go there, they demand multiple exams and they are taking longer and longer to update on the results of those set exams. For example, my dog has recurrent bladder infections, it’s something genetic, but they always demand a pre and post antibiotic test. I’ve been waiting for the results since 11/13, after paying almost 600 dollars in all exams. Additionally my dog was there to get tested and they forgot to let me know to pick her up, I had to stop by to pick her up because I was worried she had been there for so long.
Love Modern Animal! Always a great service for my two kitties.

I am a long-time Playa Vista resident, and this was my first time ever visiting a vet clinic because my dog has never been sick before. The two ladies at the front desk were very kind, but when they tried to explain their system and I didn’t fully understand, they brought out a white female doctor to “clarify.” I don’t know her name, but her attitude was unacceptable.

She spoke to me with obvious impatience and gave me a cold, hostile look — as if I was wasting her time by simply trying to understand how things work. It was rude, unprofessional, and unnecessary negative energy.

After eight years living in this community, I expect better from a business that’s supposed to serve local residents. I had hoped this clinic would be a convenient, reliable place for my dog in the future, but this experience made it very clear that this is not the place I can trust.

If you don’t want to be disrespected or talked down to by a doctor with a terrible attitude, I strongly recommend going somewhere else.
Hi Jacquie, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

When I lived in SoCal, I brought my anxious dog here for all our veterinary needs, and we were always met with welcoming, caring professionals and great overall care. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone, but especially if your dog struggles with veterinary or general anxiety. Sadly, we no longer live in an area with access to clinics, but even my experience of changing membership to fit our lives right now was so incredibly positive! It can be expensive, but I always found it was worth it for my and my dog’s peace of mind.
Good quality care by people that were honest and genuine. The team and Dr. Le were amazing as always.

We have really enjoyed our experience at Modern Animal, I find that you truly get what you pay for and am pleased with the experiences including regular visits, dental cleaning, nail trim, etc. We have been to Culver City, Playa Vista, and Manhattan Beach locations. They always welcome our 90 lb girl with love (and we get treated really well, too!). Happy customers, thanks for bringing us to MA, Dr, Flanigan. 🐾
My 1st time there & it was so great!! They gave me a lot of time & information & they treated my dog like a queen!!

I had a deeply unpleasant experience this morning. I parked briefly in what appeared to be a public parking. Within moments, a staff member from the front desk came outside with a clipboard approached my car , saw me, and went back inside. I was in my car for no longer than a few minutes before moving it--but before I could even leave, she came back out, raised her voice, and very aggressively said, "You cannot park here. I will make sure you get towed next time. Security is aware!"

I explained that I was already moving my car, but she proceeded to take out her phone and began photographing me and my license plate while I was inside my vehicle. When I asked why she was taking pictures, she said it was to "report me to security" and "keep it in their system." She then held the hospital door open, and continued shouting--at one point even threatening that she would sue me if I "posted anything."

The hostility and lack of professionalism were shocking. I was already leaving and posed no issue, yet this staff member escalated the situation unnecessarily, in full view of others. If this is how they treat people in the parking lot, I can only imagine the lack of empathy and respect shown to actual patients or their families. Over parking that was already addressed.. not even 5 mins... she makes the parking police look great!

This kind of behavior is unacceptable in a healthcare setting. I will be escalating this matter to corporate and contacting the plaza management to verify whether my personal information and photos are being stored without my consent. If so, I will take further action as needed.

I do not recommend this hospital to anyone seeking compassionate or professional care.

Modern Animal is by far the best clinic I have visited in my area. What a wonderful team of competent, loving and patient professionals. Grateful to have finally found proper care along with excellent customer service.

Modern Animal vets are always so knowledgeable and professional. I like that I can book at many locations too. Dr. Jennifer Bonnell and Dr. Shim at the Playa Vista location are great. Dr. Storm and Dr. Yang (with a shoutout to nurse Jennifer) at the Manhattan Beach location are awesome too. I had good experiences with Dr. Ramirez and Dr. Nitido at the Culver City branch, but Dr. Nitido has moved on. Really, you can’t go wrong with these excellent vets, nurses, and techs. The annual membership price can be high in the event you have multiple pets, but I probably go more often as a result, meaning I get little things seen to that I might skip when dealing with the hassle of an overwhelmed non-membership vet center. I haven’t had difficultly getting an appointment within a couple of days, all of which can be booked on their app, where they offer phone call, video, and chat functions with nurses in order to speak to someone quickly without having to bring your pets in.
Disappointing.

We’re sorry to hear your visit didn’t meet expectations. Our team always aims to provide thoughtful, high-quality care for both pets and their people. We’d love to learn more and see how we can make things right. Please reach out to us directly at hello@modernanimal.com.

I am very disappointed with this place, Dr. Bonnell is like every other doctor, sold out to the medical companies that push vaccines and medications that cause serious side effects. After following her exact protocol for my dog, cytopoint, appoquel, food restrictions, vaccinations, medications, my dog had almost died and has a host of problems because of the unconscionable practice of overmedicating and over vaccinating our dogs.  She would not even allow me to get a anti nausea drug that had less harmful effects and was cheaper, though she claimed her medication was cheaper it was not, it has to be her way all the time and my dog has suffered greatly without any remedy because of this place.

I cannot say enough good things about all of our experiences at Modern Animal!  Every single person in each office has been friendly, and knowledgeable.  The app is easy to use, and when we needed to, our online chat with a veterinary professional was thorough and efficient.  You are a part of your pet's care team, and you're never told what you must or must not do.

Thank you for the fantastic rating, Janis! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a great experience. Your satisfaction motivates us to keep delivering our best. Please feel free to write back or email us at hello@modernanimal.com providing us the feedback on your service so we can continue to provide the same care. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

Thank you for your wonderful rating, Brenda! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a great experience. Your satisfaction motivates us to keep delivering our best. Please feel free to write back or email us at hello@modernanimal.com providing us the feedback on your service so we can continue to provide the same care. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

The best vet I have found in LA, no matter which location you go to. They are so friendly, helpful, accommodating and quick to get you and your pup what you need. The techs are all so sweet and take great care of my dog each time. The facility itself is also incredible - so clean, updated, warm and treats for dogs and humans. The app also makes life 1000000x easier to schedule, get prescriptions, ask a question etc. I don’t know why more vets don’t adopt a similar process when it comes to admin. Prices also extremely good and less than other vets I’ve been to in LA like the VAC vets. Also love how transparent it is and they never push you to do anything you aren’t comfortable with.

Have had great experiences at Modern Animal and have recommended it to plenty of friends, until this past month when my cat got diabetes.

When my cat was first diagnosed with diabetes I was told to wait 7-14 days to have a glucose monitor installed because it’s “too early”. On day 4 he had a significant blood sugar spike that landed him in the ER. The morning after the ER visit I went to modern animal again and requested that the glucose monitor be installed and was refused it again because it’s “too early”. Today he is back at modern animal with a dangerously low glucose reading. In my opinion all of these visits could have been avoided had I been allowed to get the monitor installed or at least given a prescription to do it myself. Not to mention the amount of hours or days he was having complications I had no read on his blood sugar because I didn’t have a reader, only allowing his condition to get worse.

I’m really upset at how much I tried to advocate for my cat so I could pay close attention to his glucose levels and was told NOT to monitor and was refused a prescription and/or installation of the monitor. Mind you the glucose monitor they recommend is prescription only! This has cost me thousands in ER/vet visits that I could have avoided by monitoring at home, and vets know the first few weeks of insulin can be difficult. I’m unsure why I was refused a monitor and forced to blindly treat his diabetes and my only guess can be that they know hysterical people like me will come in and pay the bill when something goes wrong. Telling someone NOT to monitor the glucose levels of a cat newly starting insulin is asinine to me

I would not recommend Dr. Le at this location at all!  She is not able to really communicate with the dog owner how to position the pet to get a good exam in!  We came in for a bump between the phalanges and to this day after paying for a cytology exam and all the wrong meds she prescribed my dog keeps getting it.  When inquired how come the treatment isnt working, their response was we didnt get enough cells for the cytology, SO WHY WOULD YOU CHARGE ME and NOT redo a test that was inconclusive???   Really poorly trained and lack of experience.  DO NOT RECOMMEND them as they push you for the tests and diagnostics that are not conclusive, and recommend meds and treatment thats way cheaper off of chewy or amazon!
Highly recommend Dr. Le. She is very professional and thorough. Very knowledgeable about procedures and handles my pets with care. I feel safe knowing my pets are in trustworthy hands.

I definitely enjoyed my visit with the doctor but unfortunately the atmosphere is filled with toxic synthetic fragrance chemicals including Febreeze, several containers of “Clear Air: Fresh Linen Gel Beeds” throughout the facility even though I have shared with the facility that I have a synthetic fragrance disability. It’s so sad and unfortunate of course for me and others with those who have MCS, MCAS, asthma, autism, migraines, who are undergoing chemotherapy, or who are pregnant, But for the animals! Who smell is 10,000 times stronger than ours and whose organs get affected by these cancer causing chemicals.
We love coming to see her 💕 …

The best vet we have ever been to and we have been to a lot between moving and/or not being happy with other vet offices due to non transparent costs, disorganization, other issues. Everybody here is so nice, welcoming, professional, and everything just WORKS. From the app to the payment process and seeing what procedures or tests are vaccines are due for your dog and the ease of chatting with the nurses and making an appt at any of their several locations. I’ve recommended to all my friends with pets. Love them. The techs are all so great. Special shoutout to Dr Shim, Dr DeVore and Dr Bonnell. Can’t go wrong here. If you’re thinking about signing up, do it!

I recently had a very difficult experience involving my two cats, who are siblings. My male cat became seriously ill and had to be taken to an emergency vet. Sadly, we were told he had feline cancer, and the vet advised us that we should urgently have his sister examined and vaccinated due to the risk of a contagious virus.

We went to Modern Animal Hospital in Playa Vista hoping to get her checked and vaccinated right away. The waiting area was empty, and I told the receptionist that I wasn't a member but was willing to pay the $200 membership fee if they could see my cat immediately. Unfortunately, I was told that even with the membership, they would require an appointment, an exam first, and maybe the vaccine after that.

We explained the urgency -- that we were unsure how much time we had, and that we couldn't risk our other cat being near her unvaccinated sister. The receptionist briefly left to speak to someone and returned to tell us they would not see her and we would have to come back another time.

We left feeling extremely disappointed. In a moment when we were anxious, emotional, and trying to act quickly for the health of our remaining cat, we were met with little empathy or flexibility. We understand policies, but sometimes there is room for compassion -- especially in urgent situations involving pet health. Sadly, we didn't experience that here.

I am grateful for finding your services. After the fires and being displaced, Bentley got so sick and we couldn’t find our Vet in the Palisades. My neighbor recommended you and Wow! 🤩 we’ve been to both Santa Monica and Playa Vista locations and each time Bentley was handled with so much love! Everything is extremely organized and both teams are stellar! Thank you Modern Animal teams for loving Bentley back to health! Grateful 🥹 ❤️🙏🏼
Wow! How is VCA still in business? What an amazing service and great people.
Seemed nicely run

I am very grateful that I brought my rescue dog into Modern Animal. I went to another Vet a few days before when I first brought Ava home and it was such an impersonal experience that afterwards I didn't feel right. At Modern Animal a few days later they gave Ava her 1st real check up. The Vet discovered a horrible ear infection in both ears.. They gave both my dog and myself time,  information, and respect. This is the most Professional Animal services I have ever received for a dog.

I give 5 stars to Modern Animal - Playa Vista. The Drs. and techs are absolutely fabulous, as they provide care and comfort to my dog. Out of all the dogs we have had during the years, my dog absolutely loves going. It certainly shows by his reaction. Thank you Modern Animal

Modern Animal is the BEST! I’ve been to the Playa Vista location twice now and can genuinely say the staff and doctors know what they’re doing and they do it well. Going to the vet is never fun, often filled with anxiety and dread (and I’m not even talking about what the pups must be feeling) but Modern Animal makes the entire experience pleasant and dare I say, fun?!? Keep it up MA!

Updating my review for the third time after being a member for over three years. To put it simply, Modern Animal is an average at best vet combined with a poorly executed tech company/app. You pay a premium for services that may or not be accurate or even the correct ones ordered. We had multiple issues trying to get prescriptions filled, the wrong bloodwork done resulting in having to have it drawn multiple times, and usually had to wait 15+ minutes to be seen for appointments. The app/tech side of Modern Animal is a joke. We typically had to wait days for responses to questions and would when we did it was often irrelevant or differing from what we were told by the vets in-person. And since you have no way of contacting a vet office or speaking to anyone locally, information and communication goes through a game of telephone where it’s passed along from one person to the next ending up in useless “care.” We’ve cancelled our membership (again) and won’t be rejoining this time.

The app is great and folks responsiveness was on point. The service in the office was very professional and pleasant. Our dog was happy to be there. Just one caution- they suggest many optional services which could lead folks to very large vet bills. We opted for treatment that served our pet’s need only.  Just an update- we went back for another round of a hypo-allergy shot which works great for 4 months.... and anyone interested to sign up with Modern Animal can do so with this free membership promotion: LALOVE as of 29April25.

Love every modern animal me and my family go to. I brought my dog to the play vista location for the first time, and they treated my Atticus so well. Very accommodating to him since he is dog reactive. Angel, who was at front desk, is amazing. He helped my dog into and out of modern animal. Love everyone here and amazing service. See you guys next time ✨
Hi johanna, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

Visits at Modern Animal are stress-free for my pup! She loves getting treats and it makes getting vaccinations, or ear-plucking almost painless because she’s so engaged in the lick mat. I love the thorough explanations of procedures and the care that they take to make sure both pet and human are comfortable. Dr. Shim is wonderful & so is Nealy!

Amazing, loved my experience with them. They aren’t pushy at all when it comes to what they are recommending for your pooch and really does their best to make your pet feel as comfortable as possible. I couldn’t be happier with my visit there and I will definitely be coming back, definitely feel like a more luxury vet clinic overall as well. 20/10
Dr. Le and her team were extremely kind and caring. I trusted my dog was in good hands throughout the whole process.

Took my puppy to the vet for the first time and it was an amazing experience! I had a huge list of questions and Dr. Teresa Le was sooo patient in answering all of them, making sure my pup felt comfortable, and documenting a care plan that was easy to follow.
I love modern animal for my pup mochi they always try to make her feel comfortable and I never feel judged for saying not yet to certain tests
Hi Amber, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Great for convenience

I love modern animal!!

I have only been to the Playa Vista location — everyone here is seriously the best! They are very patient with all my new dog mom questions (!) and attentive throughout our entire visit. I never feel rushed AND they make every effort to make us feel so comfortable.

Thank you so much for taking care of us!!

We love modern animal!! It seriously changed our entire experience with vets.

My pup was terrified of vets prior to us moving to modern animal. Hannah was the absolute best, so patient and attentive and really made an effort to make her feel so comfortable.

We have a new member of our pack, a little kitten who was a stray- she has been cared for so wonderfully by Dr Shim and Nellie. And Angel always makes sure us pet parents are taken care of as well!!

We love modern animal! Thank you so much for taking care of us!!

I am new to modern animal and it has been an amazing experience. I’ve had a chance to go to the culver location and this location here in Playa. It was a great experience from Angel at the front and the service with Dr. Shim. From the ease of making make appointments and having accessibility to all the records on the app!
Hi ABE, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Hi Ольга, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

Great Vet office. Clean, professional, helpful, reassuring, caring, knowledgeable, kind and patient.
Met with Dr Johnson and techs Destiny/Julio. Check up with two dogs. Blood test …
Hi Channon, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
